summary: Completed backend and frontend validation for password-protected access, credit-based generate flows, admin CRUD, insufficient-credit handling, and SEBI disclaimer visibility on the public preview URL.
action_items: Optional hardening: remove default fallback admin password in backend and require ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD via environment.
Optional hardening: replace in-memory SESSION_STORE with persistent/expiring session strategy for multi-instance resilience.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ.get('ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD', 'owner123'), which leaves a predictable default admin password if env is missing.
Auth sessions are stored in process memory without TTL; app restarts or horizontal scaling can invalidate sessions unexpectedly.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary users via admin UI/API during CRUD and insufficient-credit tests; all created test users were deleted in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL regression is stable. Pytest currently passes 14/14 including new auth-credit-admin suite. Frontend run validated landing gate, admin login, no pre-population before generate clicks, credit deductions (-1 multibagger, -2 F&O), Top 4 panel population, admin CRUD, and insufficient-credit error rendering.
rca of the issue: No functional defect reproduced in this cycle. Observed 402 in browser console during sample-user F&O generate is expected behavior for insufficient credits and is surfaced correctly in UI.
